testcase.name: Scenario: Open and cancel the first save: tmp/obk-open-save-48987af/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:4:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open and cancel the first save ✔ Given a new unsaved part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user presses Control+S ✔ Then a Save As dialog opens ✔ And a proposed document name is selected in the file name field ✔ And a location, file type and preview options are displayed ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ Then the Save As dialog closes ✔ And the unsaved part remains active ✔ When the user presses Control+S again in the same session ✔ Then the Save As dialog reopens with the same proposed document name selected ✔ When the user cancels the dialog again ✔ Then the unsaved part remains active
